text:
Maya: Heads up — Acme says a competitor shipped a low-cost per-route routing + fallback offering. They want to know if we can match. Need quick triage on scope vs speed.
Jordan: Yikes. Any rough engineering estimate?
Maya: Sales pushed for an ETA tied to their renewal.
Priya: If we can show a focused solution quickly, Acme might commit. Recommend narrow scope.
Alex: Tech thought: we could expose a backend-only policy that picks model variants per tenant by cost, no UI initially.
Jordan: Ballpark: 2 sprints for backend plus rollout and ops. If we can reuse existing policy engine it might be smaller.
Ravi: Design can mock a single toggle and a small admin surface for demos in 48 hours.
Sam: Caution: avoid chasing feature parity that dilutes our differentiators. We need to decide whether this is premium or part of existing tiers.
Maya: Proposed launch criteria: perf parity (p95 decision <50ms), API stability, docs + billing flag, and runbook.
Jordan: Rollout plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% with auto-fallback to baseline.
ops-bot: Note: maintenance window 03:00 UTC open for risky deploys.
Priya: Sales needs an ETA by EOD. Can we run a spike today?
Alex: I'll spike routing reuse tomorrow AM. If we can plug into KV cache and existing hooks, estimate ~5 days for MVP.
Jordan: I'll join the spike. If reuse works, build MVP for Hosted Pro and Dedicated.
Maya: Decision rule: if spike <=5d and perf targets look doable, greenlight narrow MVP; else deprioritize to Q4.
Priya: We could offer a Hosted beta limited to top-tier customers to speed deployment.
Sam: Messaging: call it "cost-aware routing controls" to keep positioning proactive.
Ravi: I'll prepare a demo flow and two admin mock screens for the beta.
Jordan: Spike owners: Jordan + Alex. ETA 72h. I'll post results here.
Jordan: Perf target for spike: p95 gateway decision <120ms to be non-disruptive.
Maya: Add to checklist: SLOs, docs, billing flag, rollout knobs, support runbook, migration notes, eval prompts.
Priya: I'll draft a customer FAQ and negotiation anchors.
Alex: Quick config to test in spike:
policy:
  selector: tenant_id
  strategy: prefer_low_cost_compatible
  fallback: baseline_model
  ttl: 60s

Jordan: If that integrates easily we avoid much plumbing.
Maya: Keep scope tight: API/flag controls only, no multi-tenant UI.
Sam: Track metric: percent routed to cheaper variant + quality delta.
Ravi: I'll make a short demo gif for Sales to use temporarily.
Maya: OK — spike results here. If green, schedule cross-functional kickoff next Tue.
Jordan: On it.
Alex: Will run spike and share a short tradeoffs doc.
Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
